bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN d.data ? 'shareCode' AND d.data::text LIKE '%写真付きのリンク%' THEN 'REGISTERED' WHEN d.data::text LIKE '%写真付きのリンク%' THEN 'BUTTONS' WHEN d.data ? 'media' OR d.data ? 'mediaExtras' THEN 'MEDIA' ELSE 'NONE' END FROM public_post_drafts d WHERE d.module='link' AND d.owner_user_id IN (SELECT owner_user_id FROM link_button_posts WHERE content='個別編集済みの安全テスト') LIMIT 1;"
v="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$sql")" || exit 61
case "$v" in REGISTERED)exit 80;; BUTTONS)exit 81;; MEDIA)exit 82;; NONE)exit 83;; *)exit 84;; esac
